veranderings.rede: 'Daardie kleur' has no antecedent: the previous sentence names the place, not its colour.

veranderings.na: Die gemiddelde wat jy so kry, staan
veranderings.rede: 'Daardie gemiddelde' points back to a word the preceding sentences never use; they only describe the calculation.

veranderings.voor: hoe warm dit op plekke is
veranderings.na: hoe warm dit op verskillende plekke is
veranderings.rede: 'op plekke' is an Afrikaans idiom for 'here and there, in some places', which misreads the definition.

veranderings.voor: saamtel en deur hulle aantal deel
veranderings.na: saamtel en die totaal deur hulle aantal deel
veranderings.rede: 'deel' has no object, so it is unclear what is divided; this also matches the study text's 'deel die totaal deur hulle aantal'.

vlae.blok: Die wêreld se drie streke / Waar die drie streke lê
vlae.teks: Die wêreld se drie streke; Waar die drie streke lê
vlae.rede: Both block headings say 'drie streke', while the protected wording in the text is 'drie soorte streke' because there are two temperate and two cold regions but one warm one. Headings cannot be changed by script, so the writer should decide whether they need 'soorte'.
